youtube.title: 🔥 Give Claude Vision for Any Video
youtube.description:
Ever paste a video link into Claude and get a useless answer because it can't actually see what's happening?

You're not alone. Claude can read webpages, browse repos, and run scripts — but out of the box, it's blind to video content. You paste a YouTube link and it guesses from the title or pulls a transcript that misses 90% of what's on screen.

Claud Video (/watch) changes that. Install it once via the Claude Code marketplace or Agent Skills CLI, and Claude gains the ability to actually watch videos. Paste any URL — YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo, local files, anything yt-dlp supports — ask a question, and Claude extracts scene-aware frames, pulls timestamped captions or Whisper transcripts, and reads every frame like it's watching alongside you.

Most videos are completely free using native captions. Whisper only kicks in when a video genuinely has no caption track. Frame deduplication automatically drops near-identical frames so you're not burning tokens on static slides or held shots.

Real use cases: analyze competitor content hooks, diagnose bugs from screen recordings, summarize hour-long tutorials into searchable notes, strip the hype out of launch videos to find what's actually new.

Zero config to start. On first run it auto-installs ffmpeg and yt-dlp via brew on macOS or prints exact commands for Linux/Windows. Works in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and 50+ Agent Skills hosts.

linkedin.text:
You paste a video link into Claude.

It gives you a generic answer pulled from the title.

Because Claude can't actually see video. 🚨

You're losing hours re-watching clips Claude could analyze in seconds. You send bug recordings that never get diagnosed. You manually scrub competitor content for hooks instead of just asking what worked.

The usual approach: copy-paste transcripts, watch at 2x, take manual notes. It's slow. You still miss what's on screen. And you're doing work an LLM should handle.

Claud Video (/watch) gives Claude actual vision for video. Install it once and Claude can watch any video you throw at it — YouTube, TikTok, local files, anything yt-dlp supports. Paste a URL, ask a question, and Claude extracts scene-aware frames, pulls timestamped captions or Whisper transcripts, and reads every frame like it's watching with you.

✅ Most videos are free using native captions — Whisper only kicks in when needed
✅ Frame deduplication drops near-identical frames so you're not burning tokens on static slides
✅ Zero config — auto-installs ffmpeg/yt-dlp on first run, works in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 50+ hosts
